v1_findings_rechecked.evidence: read_verified_raw_bytes bounds the opened raw read to RAW_BYTES+1, validates opened/path fingerprints, requires exact bytes type and length, and hashes the immutable content against RAW_SHA. The same verified bytes are wrapped by io.BytesIO and supplied to torch.load with map_location='cpu'. The path is not reopened by torch.load.
v1_findings_rechecked.remaining_trust_boundary: weights_only=False remains explicitly limited to the fixed expected SHA produced by the trusted frozen worker. Installed Python/torch/NumPy imports remain trusted environment dependencies. CPU mapping alone is not a pickle sandbox, but the v1 pathname-to-unpickler gap is closed.

v1_findings_rechecked.evidence: HF independently derives the packed prediction index from prior flat attention counts and the selected row prefix length, or derives row*response_width+token_index for the dense normalizer index. It requires the saved selected index to match and additionally checks the actual following model-input target. vLLM requires statistic selected-flat index and target to match the sampler mapping and exact-chain entry, binds the selected row through physical runner index/request/sequence/prediction position, checks its preceding input token, and checks the reported selected logit, LSE and normalized logp against the index entry.
v1_findings_rechecked.scope: These checks apply to the sampled-support and retained-support maxima actually emitted by targeted(). The existing frozen helper continues checking complete chosen-probability chain coverage. No all-rank or all-turn probability acceptance follows.

v1_findings_rechecked.evidence: Both vector-presence predicates are unchanged and still inspect only selected_flat_index and target_id. Neither accesses or validates logits_fp32.
The success path still checks payload.encode('utf-8') before adding the newline. The refusal path has no explicit complete-emission byte-bound check.

blocking_findings.title: Vector-presence flags still verify labels without verifying vector existence
blocking_findings.fact: A matching dictionary containing only selected_flat_index and target_id passes the current any() predicate even if logits_fp32 is absent.
blocking_findings.effect: bounded_full_vocab_vector_present can be true without an actual stored full-vocabulary vector. This violates the stated absence-safe presence claim.
blocking_findings.minimal_correction: Replace both any() predicates with a small reader-only validation helper: find matching records by selected_flat_index/target_id; return false for an empty match set; require exactly one record otherwise; require that record's logits_fp32 exists and is a one-dimensional CPU torch.Tensor of dtype torch.float32 with numel() equal to stats['vocabulary_size']; then return true. Refuse malformed or duplicate matching records. Serialize only the boolean, never the vector values.
blocking_findings.observation_limit: The actual remote vectors were not inspected. This is the unchanged concrete static predicate failure.

blocking_findings.title: The stdout cap still excludes the final newline
blocking_findings.fact: A JSON payload of exactly MAX_STDOUT_BYTES is accepted and then one newline byte is added by sys.stdout.write.
blocking_findings.effect: The accepted success-path upper bound is 32769 bytes instead of the required 32768-byte complete stdout cap.
blocking_findings.minimal_correction: Construct the final emitted string including its newline, require len(final_text.encode('utf-8')) <= MAX_STDOUT_BYTES, and only then write it. Apply the same explicit complete-output bound to the refusal string, using a short constant refusal fallback if needed. No interpreter/model/test execution is required to make this change.
blocking_findings.observation_limit: No actual diagnostic output size was measured. This is the unchanged exact boundary condition.

retained_positive_static_checks: The fixed raw/binding/HF-normalizer/helper identities are unchanged from v1, including source 2ddbb0a1619ce7cde28b4c5be110ffe5bd11c963, raw SHA313d2902783e1e0e0fd2ff1560565a82cff92bd74cb0d900201f0acbd9082085 and binding SHA2c161a96fd4f1313e1c5de935a98319bf85b9247b4c7632c73afac282ed500ec.
All input paths remain fixed, extra execution arguments are refused, and explicit bytecode/CUDA environment guards precede main's helper imports.

Frozen helpers are loaded only from verified exact source bytes, with no preloaded same-name helper allowed. The invoked helper call graph performs CPU tensor and metadata validation, not observer setup or any original model invocation.
The reader does not import model/vLLM/training modules or invoke the scientific normalizer. It only reads and hashes the scientific source file.

The raw is loaded onto CPU from exact verified immutable bytes, then checked for source/binding/phase/serial/rank/PID identity. Typed repeated saved state, PID/start ticks, scheduler step and LR checks remain exact.

Sample-support tensors, finite probabilities, full sample masks, exact HF inputs/outputs, actual vLLM runner/model input identities and full selected-probability chain coverage continue to use the frozen validators.

The rank3 first-turn mapping still requires 320 rows, source960+local, step0, actual retained token prefix and actual sampled lengths, with retained support contained in sampled support and trailing retained EOS excluded.

Output diagnostic sums remain signed token SUMs on the saved retained first-turn actor prefix. FP32 selected-logit/LSE residual decomposition remains observation only, and complete old/current/reference all-turn action parity is explicitly pending.
Success and refusal schema versions are both v2. probability_accepted and approval_emitted remain false, selected_tolerances remains null, and no threshold is inferred from the discrepancy.

No explicit file-write, process-signal, training RPC, new model-forward, sampling, RNG draw or state-restore call was introduced. The only raw validator mutation is in the separately loaded in-memory dictionary.
limitations: Static review only: no reader, tests, native/CPU controls, SSH, GPU operation, model code or remote PT deserialization was executed.

The remote PT, call0 receipt, prefix snapshot, current live worker and current training state were not inspected. Constants and saved-identity validation logic do not constitute a new live-process observation.

The five frozen helpers and relevant producer/HF-normalizer source were read in the preceding clean-context v1 review; v2 retains their exact source hashes and binding constants. This review did not rerun those helper functions.
Local file reads, byte counts, hashes, source diff and report JSON parsing were used only for static review. The reader source was not changed.
No transport execution approval, numerical probability acceptance, tolerance selection, gate bypass or training-resume authorization is provided.
